name: fetch-display-data
description: Fetch data from an API and display it with loading/error states

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript class that fetches user data and manages loading/error states. Include proper interfaces.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript class that fetches user data and manages loading/error states.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript class with JSDoc that fetches user data and manages loading/error states.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a user list that fetches and displays data from JSONPlaceholder API. Include:

**Features:**
- Fetch users from https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users
- Show loading spinner while fetching
- Display users in cards (name, email, company)
- Show error message if fetch fails
- Retry button on error
- Search/filter users by name

**HTML:**
- Container for user cards
- Loading spinner element
- Error message container
- Search input

**CSS:**
- Grid layout for user cards
- Card styling with shadow/hover
- Spinner animation
- Error styling
- Responsive grid

**JavaScript:**
- Async fetch with try/catch
- State management (loading, error, data)
- Render functions for different states
- Filter/search functionality

Return as single HTML file with working demo.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Same as javascript-vanilla-web with complete JSDoc:
- @typedef User
- @typedef AppState
- Document all functions
- Include examples in JSDoc

Return as single HTML file.
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a data fetching component using TypeScript and vanilla Web APIs. Include:

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for User type
- Type-safe fetch function
- State management with types
- Proper error typing

**Features:**
- Generic data fetching utility
- Loading/error/success states
- Retry logic
- Search/filter

**Architecture:**
- Separate modules (api, state, render)
- Type-safe throughout

Provide TypeScript source and HTML structure.
variants.typescript-react:
Create a user list component using TypeScript React. Include:

**Component:**
- UserList component
- UserCard component
- LoadingSpinner component
- ErrorMessage component

**Custom Hook:**
- useFetch<T> hook with TypeScript
- Returns: { data, loading, error, refetch }

**TypeScript:**
- Interface for User
- Generic useFetch hook
- Proper component prop types

**Features:**
- Fetch from JSONPlaceholder
- Loading state
- Error handling with retry
- Search/filter
- Suspense-ready (optional)

**Example:**
```tsx
const { data, loading, error, refetch } = useFetch<User[]>(
  'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users'
);
```

No external data fetching libraries (no React Query, SWR, etc.).
